about_the_game:
Note: the art found on this page, in screenshots and in the demo is not final. All artwork both inside and outside the demo and screenshots are subject to change before release.

Meet February, the magical, forgetful and slightly bonkers explorer who you will play as. She finds herself in a world with only one thing to do: keep running!

The demo currently has the following features:

  • A Tutorial level, that is not procedurally generated.

  • An endless adventure with very high difficultly where you can race against the clock to explore longer and longer procedurally generated worlds.

  • Local save files to resume the adventure where you left off.
